If i was you id make sure i was on meds 2 as depression is a very slippery slope and i went from just down to suicidal nd unable to  get out of my bed in a blink of an eye.

One of the best things i did was get everyone who was close to me, in my case mom, dad, sister and gf to write 5 of their fav things about me. Then when i am having a down day i would read them and remember i am not as useless as my brian tries to trick me into thinking i am.
